Bootstrap gromit configuration and templates in the current directory.

Creates:
  gromit.yaml           - Configuration file
  .gromit/
    templates/         - Prompt templates
      PROMPT_build.md
      PROMPT_validate.md
      PROMPT_analyze.md
      PROMPT_retro.md
      PROMPT_scope.md
      PROMPT_decompose.md
      PROMPT_review.md
      PROMPT_thorough_review.md
      PROMPT_learn.md
    specs/             - Specification files (empty)
    plans/             - Plan files (empty)

Usage:
  gromit init [flags]

Flags:
  -f, --force   Overwrite existing files
  -h, --help    help for init

Global Flags:
  -c, --config string   Path to config file (default "gromit.yaml")
